question: Write a letter to the editor of a newspaper about the need to improve road safety near schools.
model_answer:
To
The Editor
[Newspaper Name]

Subject: Need to improve road safety near schools

Sir/Madam,
Through the columns of your newspaper, I wish to draw attention to the safety problems faced by students near schools. Heavy traffic, speeding vehicles and the absence of safe crossings put children at risk during school hours. The authorities should provide zebra crossings, warning signs, speed-control measures and traffic supervision at busy times. Schools can also conduct regular road-safety awareness programmes. I request you to highlight this issue so that the concerned authorities may take prompt action.

Yours faithfully,
[Name]

question: Write a letter to your friend describing how you are preparing for your Class 10 final examination.
model_answer:
Dear Rohan,

I hope you are doing well. I am writing to tell you about my preparation for the Class 10 final examination. I have prepared a simple timetable and revise one subject at a time. I practise previous questions, write answers within the required time and make a short list of difficult topics for revision. I also take regular breaks and get enough sleep so that I can study with concentration. I hope your preparation is going well too. Do write back and tell me about your study plan.

Yours lovingly,
[Name]

question: Write a letter to the Municipal Commissioner requesting regular waste collection and clean surroundings in your locality.
model_answer:
To
The Municipal Commissioner
[City/Municipality]

Subject: Request for regular waste collection

Sir/Madam,
I am a resident of [locality] and wish to bring to your notice the irregular collection of waste in our area. Garbage remains on roadsides for several days and sometimes blocks drains, creating an unpleasant and unhealthy environment. I request the municipality to arrange regular collection, provide separate bins for wet and dry waste and take suitable action against open dumping. Awareness programmes can also encourage residents to cooperate. Kindly take necessary action at the earliest.

Yours faithfully,
[Name]

question: Write a letter to your cousin inviting him or her to spend the summer vacation with you.
model_answer:
Dear Anu,

How are you? Our summer vacation is beginning next month and I would be very happy if you could spend a few days with us. We can visit the nearby places, read together and enjoy the evenings with our family. I have already told my parents about your visit and they are looking forward to meeting you. Please ask your parents and let me know your travel dates soon. I am eagerly waiting to see you.

With love,
[Name]

question: Write a letter to the Headmaster requesting better drinking-water facilities in your school.
model_answer:
To
The Headmaster
[School Name]

Subject: Request for better drinking-water facilities

Respected Sir/Madam,
I am a student of Class 10 and wish to bring to your notice the need for improved drinking-water facilities in our school. During the warmer months, the existing arrangements are often insufficient for students. I request the school to provide additional safe drinking-water points, maintain the existing filters regularly and ensure that the water facilities remain clean. These measures would benefit all students. Kindly consider the request.

Yours obediently,
[Name]
Class 10

question: Write a letter to your friend describing a memorable school event you recently attended.
model_answer:
Dear Meera,

I hope you are fine. I want to tell you about a school event that I will remember for a long time. Our school organised a cultural programme in which students presented songs, speeches, dances and a short play. I took part in the programme with my classmates, and our teachers helped us prepare for several days. The most exciting moment was when our class received appreciation for the play. Everyone worked together and the atmosphere was joyful. I wish you had been there with us.

Yours lovingly,
[Name]
